$comment: DevRites hooks call the global `devrites-engine` binary after an inline missing-binary check. The standard profile requires exact one-shot authority for destructive Git, approves only the engine's read-only helpers, injects active-workspace orientation, enforces declared leaf boundaries, records test and build failures, and checks Stop consistency. Use DEVRITES_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal|standard|strict for the shared profile and DEVRITES_DISABLED_HOOKS=<comma-separated ids> to disable hooks. When active, `git-guard` is enforced. The legacy A1 and Stop gates observe by default unless their own enforcement switch or the strict profile enables enforcement. Reviewer and wright guards live in agent frontmatter. DEVRITES_INGEST_WARNING=warn enables Claude's metadata-only WebFetch warning trial. The installer merges these hooks without replacing unrelated user settings.

statusLine.command: command -v devrites-engine >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec devrites-engine hook statusline --harness=claude || exit 0
